control_points.label: Roode Steen
control_points.source: Archeologie West-Friesland marker disc on the annotated 1560 plan; disc centre found by colour segmentation (area 11913 px, bbox 138x130). RD is the centroid of the 21 geocoded Roode Steen addresses.
control_points.notes: The square is ~72x78 m, so the RD centroid carries roughly +/-20 m. The disc sits on a five-way street junction, matching the documented crossing of the ring dike (Kleine/Grote Oost - Roode Steen - het West) and the watercourse through Kerkstraat. The coloured annotation LINES are schematic, not surveyed - the brown dike is drawn straight while the real route bends ~57 deg at this junction - so they cannot supply further control points; only the disc is usable.

notes: Best pre-1600 target: clearest true plan of the set. This record refers to the high-resolution city detail crop (uitsnede); the full regional sheet is a separate image (02AA_Hoorn_VanDeventer_1560_bis.jpg, 1500x1667) and would need its own record and transform. Scan is a 19th-c Smulders lithographic facsimile, so facsimile redrawing is a possible extra error source. EXPERT ANCHOR FOUND: Vereniging Oud Hoorn's "Het ontstaan van Hoorn" publishes this plan annotated by Archeologie West-Friesland, with a marker disc on the Roode Steen. That is one control point pinned without guesswork; a similarity fit still needs at least one more, and more than two to get a meaningful residual.
